newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wedgwood in talks to buy Rosenthal - magazine.
newsitem.headline: Wedgwood in talks to buy Rosenthal - magazine.

text.p: British porcelain maker Waterford Wedgwood plc plans to take over German rival Rosenthal AG, the German news magazine Focus reported on Sunday.

The two companies have been talks for several months and the main obstacle to the takeover is a limit on voting rights at Rosenthal which prevents individual shareholders owning more than five percent of the voting capital, Focus said in an advance copy of a report to be published in Monday's edition.
Rosenthal announced last week that it made a loss of 10.7 million marks ($7.07 million) in the first half of 1996 after a loss of 13.1 million marks in the same period a year earlier.
Its sales fell to 151.5 million marks from 165.1 million. ($1=1.5126 Mark)
